name: Giant Weasel
traits: Player traits from Tyler Kamstra’s Monstrous Races, v2, for 2014 fifth edition.
Medium Beast. Dexterity increases by 2. Walk 35 ft. Typical alignment is neutral.
Bite deals 1d6 slashing as an unarmed strike. Use Strength or Dexterity for the bite, which counts as a finesse weapon for effects such as Sneak Attack.
Darkvision 60 ft. Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on hearing or smell have advantage.
No hands for weapons, shields, or gear that requires manipulation. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Giant Wolf Spider
traits: Player traits from Tyler Kamstra’s Monstrous Races, v2, for 2014 fifth edition.
Medium Beast. Strength and Dexterity each increase by 1. Walk and climb 40 ft. Typical alignment is neutral.
Bite deals 1d4 piercing and 1d4 poison as an unarmed strike. Use Strength or Dexterity for the bite, which counts as a finesse weapon for effects such as Sneak Attack.
While unarmored, base AC is 11 + Dexterity modifier. Darkvision 60 ft.
Climbs awkward surfaces and ceilings without ability checks. Webbing cannot restrict its movement.
No hands for weapons, shields, or gear that requires manipulation. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Hawk
traits: Player traits from Tyler Kamstra’s Monstrous Races, v2, for 2014 fifth edition.
Tiny Beast. Dexterity increases by 2 and Wisdom by 1. Walk 10 ft. and fly 60 ft. when free of medium or heavy armor. Typical alignment is neutral.
Talons deal 1d4 slashing as an unarmed strike. Use Strength or Dexterity. The attack counts as a finesse weapon for applicable effects.
Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight have advantage.
No hands for weapons, shields, or gear that requires manipulation. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Hunter Shark
traits: Player traits from Tyler Kamstra’s Monstrous Races, v2, for 2014 fifth edition.

Beast. The printed size line is blank. This build uses Medium as specified in the p. 249 design notes. Strength increases by 2 and Constitution by 1. Walk 0 ft. and swim 40 ft. Typical alignment is neutral. Breathes only underwater.
Blindsight 30 ft. While unarmored, AC is 11 + Dexterity modifier.
Bite deals 1d8 piercing as an unarmed strike.
Blood Frenzy. Land an unarmed strike as part of the Attack action to make a bonus-action unarmed strike against that same target.
No hands for weapons, shields, or gear that requires manipulation. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.
Giant Shark uses this same playable trait block by the printed cross-reference on p. 244.

name: Jackal
traits: Player traits from Tyler Kamstra’s Monstrous Races, v2, for 2014 fifth edition.
Small Beast. Dexterity increases by 2 and Wisdom by 1. Walk 40 ft. Typical alignment is neutral.
Bite deals 1d4 slashing as an unarmed strike. Use Strength or Dexterity for the bite, which counts as a finesse weapon for effects such as Sneak Attack.
Pack Tactics. Use a bonus action to give the next attack roll this turn advantage if a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of that target.
No hands for weapons, shields, or gear that requires manipulation. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.
